messages.subject: M2 progress information
parts:
Hi there,

just a quick question: M2() can take quite a long time to compute, especially with high-dimensional models. Would it be possible to implement some kind of progress indicator (as is already done in DIF()), or at least a periodic sign of life to indicate the function is still running?

Thanks for all your great work on mirt!

Best regards,
Martin
